name: Suriname

facts.religion: Hindu about 22%, Protestant about 23%, Catholic about 22%, Muslim about 14%

system_note: The president is elected by parliament.
snapshot: Suriname's first woman president, Jennifer Geerlings-Simons, took office in 2025 as the country prepares for an offshore oil boom.
culture: Suriname is one of the world's most ethnically diverse countries, with Hindustani, Creole, Maroon, Javanese, Indigenous, Chinese and Dutch communities. Dutch is official, but Sranan Tongo is the common street language. A mosque and synagogue stand side by side in Paramaribo, whose wooden colonial centre is UNESCO-listed.
society: More than 90 percent of the country is covered in rainforest. Gold and oil drive exports, and TotalEnergies' offshore field is due to start producing in 2028. The country went through a debt default and high inflation earlier this decade.
baseline: Jennifer Geerlings-Simons, a doctor and long-time speaker of parliament from the National Democratic Party founded by the late dictator Dési Bouterse, was elected president by parliament in July 2025 after her party narrowly won the May election.
